title: 外倾低勾跟平衡
description: 粉彩描绘膝高岩包上的低勾跟与另一只正向支撑脚。

art_direction.medium: editorial geometric illustration with credible adult proportions
art_direction.scene: An original pastel illustration depicts a fictional fully clothed adult using a low heel hook as a balance aid on a shallow overhang. The heel rests on a broad knee-high volume, the other shoe presses a visible positive foothold, and both hands stay on large rounded edges. Keep the torso compact and close to the wall, with no airborne movement or extreme twisting. Use a medium-wide side angle that clearly shows both shoe contacts and the thick continuous crash mat directly below. Soft lavender, deep teal, and ochre pigments create a peaceful gym scene. Maintain credible adult anatomy. Exclude lettering, brands, high exposure, swinging feet, and blocked landing.
